kids.content: DEPARTMENf OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS

In line with the mandate of the Department of providing effective standards to be used in the implementation of various infrastructure projects, the attached standard design drawings for roads are hereby prescribed, for the guidance and compliance of all concerned:

list items.content: 4. Raised Median Island ,5. Auxiliary Lanes for Right and Left Turning Vehicles (Design Speed = 40 kph)

kids.content: The use of PrecastConcrete Curb and Precast Concrete Curb and Gutter shall be mandatory for all road projects. Cast-in-place concrete curb and gutter may still be adopted provided that concrete paver shall be used.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
